  THURSDAY, MARCH 20, 2025
  1800 EAST WARDLOW ROAD

 REGULAR AGENDA

 1.  25-54717  Recommendation to approve March 6, 2025 Board meeting minutes.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

 4.  25-54720  Recommendation to authorize the General Manager to execute a Schedule I,
  Transaction-Based Natural Gas Storage Service Agreement and any necessary
  amendments with the Southern California Gas Company for natural gas storage
  capacity rights in an amount not to exceed $1,846,510, for a period of one year.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

 5.  25-54721  Recommendation to adopt Resolution No. UT-1533 authorizing the General
  Manager to execute a contract, and any necessary subsequent amendments, with
  W.W. Grainger, Inc., of Lake Forest, IL, for furnishing and delivering maintenance,
  repair, operations supplies and related materials for a wide range of fieldwork
  needs, on the same terms and conditions afforded to the City of Tucson, AZ,
  through Omnia Partners, in an annual amount not to exceed $750,000 until the
  Omnia Partners contract expires on December 31, 2027, with the option to renew
  for as long as the Omnia Partners contract is in effect, at the discretion of the

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

6.  25-54722  Recommendation to adopt Resolution No. UT-1534 authorizing the General
  Manager to execute a contract, and any necessary subsequent amendments, with
  Majestic Fire, Inc., dba Kord Fire Protection, of Van Nuys, CA, for providing fire
  extinguishers and maintenance services, on the same terms and conditions
  afforded to the County of Orange, CA, in an annual amount not to exceed
  $100,000, until the County of Orange, CA, contract expires on November 15, 2028,
  with the option to renew for as long as the County of Orange, CA, contract is in
  effect, at the discretion of the General Manager.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

7.  25-54723  Recommendation to receive and file the Long Beach Utilities Department Business
  Plan Update – Part 2.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

8.  25-54728  Board Workshop:
  Recommendation to receive and file Natural Gas 101 and Regulatory Update.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

9.  25-54727  Recommendation to receive and file additional background information for the
  Board Retreat.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

PUBLIC COMMENT

Opportunity to address the Utilities Commission on non-agenda items. Each speaker is limited to
three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the Board.

8.  25-54728  Board Workshop:
  Recommendation to receive and file Natural Gas 101 and Regulatory Update.

  (AGENDA ITEM 8 WAS TAKEN BEFORE AGENDA ITEM 7)

  President Maguire called on Tony Foster, Senior Director Business Services,
  Utilities Department, to provide the staff report.

  Tony Foster, Director of Business Services, Utilities Department, introduced Lisa
  Gast, and Susie Berlin from Law Offices of Duncan, Weinberg, Genzer &
  Pembroke, for a workshop on the natural gas industry. Lisa Gast provided an
  overview of the regulatory framework and gas supply chain, highlighting key
  differences from water utilities. Susie Berlin discussed trends like decarbonization,
  electrification, and challenges facing Long Beach Utilities, to prepare the board for
  the upcoming retreat.
